reply_text:
I posted the list in #strategic-pod as a reply to you. It has five Vantorre Group ticket references, each with its source:

1. #8841 (Pemberline Dock support). The sources conflict. Gideon said on 1 Jul that he closed it. The 5/4 digest says it was still open at Allentown, and the 9/30 digest says Mateo filed it for Newark and escalated it.
2. #PD-8841 (missed carrier check-ins, Allentown). Source: 4/27 digest. It may or may not be the same as #8841.
3. #PD-4418 (Carrier_Dwell_Summary timestamps, Dock Door 9). Source: 9/15 digest. That digest says "the account Nadia runs," which I took to mean Vantorre Group. Please confirm.
4. INC-4821 (Hartford status-page access). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, 3 Aug, Gideon.
5. VT-55120 (root cause of the Hartford kiosk outage). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, 14 Oct, Gideon.

I left out #4812 (Mobility) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather). The digests also describe several Vantorre issues that have no ticket number, and I did not list those. I read the Strategic digests, the cheat sheet and the channels you can see. I did not run a search across all channels.
